method: 60 sequential POSTs with httpx from the boreal-ui container to http://api:8000 on the same Docker network (no host port proxy), image boreal-api:d4
finding: Through Docker Desktop's Windows port proxy, Locust saw ~55 ms median on POST endpoints and the API's own middleware measured p95 54-70 ms, while GET endpoints stayed at ~2 ms: the extra ~45 ms is the proxy delaying the request body (TCP delayed-ACK), not model time. Inside the Docker network /predict p95 is 13.5 ms. Analysed further in D5.
